answer_1.quote: We propose an end-to-end approach for synthetic QA data generation. ... our model comprises a single transformer‑based encoder‑decoder network that is trained end‑to‑end to generate both the answer and the question.

answer_2.quote: We trained QGen models on both BART‑Large and GPT2‑Medium ... and evaluated BLEU score of the generated question w.r.t. the ground truth question on the SQuAD dev set. BART and GPT2 achieved 21.29 and 18.31 BLEU, respectively.
